title: Return invalid_client for failed client assertions

files.patch:
@@ -344,6 +344,14 @@ server verifies it against the stored inline JWKS and rejects replay while the
 assertion is valid. No `client_secret` is included in registration or token
 exchange.
 
+Every failed assertion check (unknown `kid`, bad signature, wrong `iss`, `sub`
+or `aud`, expired or not yet valid, `exp` more than 5 minutes ahead, reused
+`jti`) is refused with HTTP 401 `invalid_client`. The `error_description`
+names the check that failed. A storage failure while checking or recording

+// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright 2025 Stacklok, Inc.
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+package server
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/url"
+
+	"github.com/ory/fosite"
+)
+
+// jwtBearerClientAssertionType is the client_assertion_type for private_key_jwt
+// client authentication (RFC 7523 section 2.2).
+const jwtBearerClientAssertionType = "urn:ietf:params:oauth:client-assertion-type:jwt-bearer"
+
+// clientAssertionClaimErrors are the messages of the claim validation errors
+// that fosite returns unwrapped, as plain errors, when it parses a client
+// assertion (see fosite/token/jwt MapClaims.Valid). fosite returns the bare
+// errors.New value and drops the ValidationError flags, so there is nothing
+// typed to match. TestClientAssertionErrorStrategy runs real fosite, so a
+// changed message fails that test on upgrade.
+var clientAssertionClaimErrors = map[string]struct{}{
+	"Token is expired":         {},
+	"Token used before issued": {},
+	"Token is not valid yet":   {},
+}
+
+type clientAssertionStoreFailureKey struct{}
+
+type clientAssertionStoreFailure struct{ err error }
+
+// RecordClientAssertionStoreFailure lets a storage backend report that it could
+// not check a client assertion's jti for a reason other than a replay. fosite
+// discards the error ClientAssertionJWTValid returns, so the client
+// authentication strategy reads it from the context instead. Storage
+// decorators must pass ctx through to the backend unchanged.
+func RecordClientAssertionStoreFailure(ctx context.Context, err error) {
+	if f, ok := ctx.Value(clientAssertionStoreFailureKey{}).(*clientAssertionStoreFailure); ok {
+		f.err = err
+	}
+}
+
+// NewClientAssertionStoreFailureContext returns a context on which
+// RecordClientAssertionStoreFailure records, and a function that returns what
+// was recorded (nil if nothing was). The client authentication strategy uses it
+// around fosite; storage tests use it to check what a backend reports.
+func NewClientAssertionStoreFailureContext(ctx context.Context) (context.Context, func() error) {
+	failure := &clientAssertionStoreFailure{}
+	return context.WithValue(ctx, clientAssertionStoreFailureKey{}, failure), func() error { return failure.err }
+}
+
+// newClientAssertionErrorStrategy makes every rejected private_key_jwt client
+// assertion surface as invalid_client, as RFC 6749 section 5.2 requires for a
+// failed client authentication.
+//
+// fosite already does this for most failures, but a few escape with another
+// error: an expired, not-yet-valid or future-issued assertion comes back as a
+// plain error (HTTP 500 server_error), and an unknown signing key or a reused
+// jti comes back as invalid_request / jti_known (HTTP 400). A request that sets
+// client_assertion_type but omits client_assertion stays invalid_request (HTTP
+// 400), as RFC 6749 section 5.2 says for a missing parameter. Errors that are
+// not a verdict on the assertion are not rewritten into invalid_client: a
+// misconfiguration is returned unchanged, and a storage failure while checking
+// the jti is reported by the storage backend through
+// RecordClientAssertionStoreFailure and returned as server_error (HTTP 500).
+func newClientAssertionErrorStrategy(next fosite.ClientAuthenticationStrategy) fosite.ClientAuthenticationStrategy {
+	return func(ctx context.Context, r *http.Request, form url.Values) (fosite.Client, error) {
+		if form.Get("client_assertion_type") != jwtBearerClientAssertionType || form.Get("client_assertion") == "" {
+			return next(ctx, r, form)
+		}
+		ctx, storeFailure := NewClientAssertionStoreFailureContext(ctx)
+		client, err := next(ctx, r, form)
+		if err == nil {
+			return client, nil
+		}
+		if failure := storeFailure(); failure != nil {
+			return nil, fosite.ErrServerError.WithWrap(failure).WithDebug(failure.Error())
+		}
+		return client, mapClientAssertionError(err)
+	}
+}
+
+func mapClientAssertionError(err error) error {
+	var rfcErr *fosite.RFC6749Error
+	if errors.As(err, &rfcErr) {
+		switch rfcErr.ErrorField {
+		// invalid_request: fosite's findPublicKey reports an unknown kid or no
+		// matching key this way. It also covers "server configuration does not
+		// support OpenID Connect specific authentication methods", which our
+		// client types never hit. jti_known: a replayed jti.
+		case fosite.ErrInvalidRequest.ErrorField, fosite.ErrJTIKnown.ErrorField:
+			return fosite.ErrInvalidClient.WithHint(rfcErr.HintField).WithWrap(err)
+		}
+		return err
+	}
+	if _, ok := clientAssertionClaimErrors[err.Error()]; ok {
+		return fosite.ErrInvalidClient.
+			WithHint("The 'client_assertion' claims could not be validated, check the iat, nbf and exp values.").
+			WithWrap(err)
+	}
+	return err
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,252 @@
+// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright 2025 Stacklok, Inc.
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+package server
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/ecdsa"
+	"crypto/elliptic"
+	"crypto/rand"
+	"errors"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"net/url"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	josev3 "github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v3"
+	"github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4"
+	"github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4/jwt"
+	"github.com/ory/fosite"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+const (
+	assertionTestIssuer   = "https://auth.example.com"
+	assertionTestTokenURL = "https://auth.example.com/oauth/token"
+	assertionTestClientID = "assertion-client"
+	assertionTestKeyID    = "client-key-1"
+)
+
+// assertionStore is the slice of fosite.Storage that client authentication
+// with a private_key_jwt assertion touches.
+type assertionStore struct {
+	fosite.Storage // unused methods panic if reached
+	client         fosite.Client
+	seen           map[string]struct{}
+	setErr         error
+	validErr       error // returned by ClientAssertionJWTValid
+	recordValidErr bool  // report validErr as a storage failure, like RedisStorage
+}
+
+func (s *assertionStore) GetClient(context.Context, string) (fosite.Client, error) {
+	return s.client, nil
+}
+
+func (s *assertionStore) ClientAssertionJWTValid(ctx context.Context, jti string) error {
+	if s.validErr != nil {
+		if s.recordValidErr {
+			RecordClientAssertionStoreFailure(ctx, s.validErr)
+		}
+		return s.validErr
+	}
+	if _, ok := s.seen[jti]; ok {
+		return fosite.ErrJTIKnown
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (s *assertionStore) SetClientAssertionJWT(_ context.Context, jti string, _ time.Time) error {
+	if s.setErr != nil {
+		return s.setErr
+	}
+	s.seen[jti] = struct{}{}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func TestClientAssertionErrorStrategy(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	key, err := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	otherKey, err := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	now := time.Now()
+	valid := func(c *jwt.Claims) {}
+	storageDown := errors.New("redis: connection refused")
+
+	tests := []struct {
+		name       string
+		mutate     func(*jwt.Claims)
+		kid        string
+		signingKey *ecdsa.PrivateKey
+		reuse      bool
+		setErr     error
+		validErr   error
+		recordErr  bool
+		noAssert   bool   // client_assertion_type set, client_assertion empty
+		wantErr    string // empty means authentication succeeds
+		wantStatus int
+	}{
+		{name: "valid assertion authenticates", mutate: valid},
+		{
+			name:    "expired assertion",
+			mutate:  func(c *jwt.Claims) { c.Expiry = jwt.NewNumericDate(now.Add(-time.Hour)) },
+			wantErr: "invalid_client", wantStatus: http.StatusUnauthorized,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "assertion issued in the future",
+			mutate:  func(c *jwt.Claims) { c.IssuedAt = jwt.NewNumericDate(now.Add(time.Hour)) },
+			wantErr: "invalid_client", wantStatus: http.StatusUnauthorized,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "assertion not valid yet",
+			mutate:  func(c *jwt.Claims) { c.NotBefore = jwt.NewNumericDate(now.Add(time.Hour)) },
+			wantErr: "invalid_client", wantStatus: http.StatusUnauthorized,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "reused jti",
+			mutate:  valid,
+			reuse:   true,
+			wantErr: "invalid_client", wantStatus: http.StatusUnauthorized,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "unknown key id",
+			mutate:  valid,
+			kid:     "no-such-key",
+			wantErr: "invalid_client", wantStatus: http.StatusUnauthorized,
+		},
+		{
+			name:       "signed with another key",
+			mutate:     valid,
+			signingKey: otherKey,
+			wantErr:    "invalid_client", wantStatus: http.StatusUnauthorized,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "wrong audience",
+			mutate:  func(c *jwt.Claims) { c.Audience = jwt.Audience{"https://elsewhere.example.com"} },
+			wantErr: "invalid_client", wantStatus: http.StatusUnauthorized,
+		},
+		{
+			name:     "jti check backend failure is a server error",
+			mutate:   valid,
+			validErr: storageDown, recordErr: true,
+			wantErr: "server_error", wantStatus: http.StatusInternalServerError,
+		},
+		{
+			name:     "jti known without a recorded failure stays invalid_client",
+			mutate:   valid,
+			validErr: fosite.ErrJTIKnown,
+			wantErr:  "invalid_client", wantStatus: http.StatusUnauthorized,
+		},
+		{
+			name:     "missing client_assertion is invalid_request",
+			mutate:   valid,
+			noAssert: true,
+			wantErr:  "invalid_request", wantStatus: http.StatusBadRequest,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "storage failure is not an authentication verdict",
+			mutate:  valid,
+			setErr:  storageDown,
+			wantErr: storageDown.Error(),
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			t.Parallel()
+
+			store := &assertionStore{
+				seen:   map[string]struct{}{},
+				setErr: tt.setErr, validErr: tt.validErr, recordValidErr: tt.recordErr,
+				client: &fosite.DefaultOpenIDConnectClient{
+					DefaultClient: &fosite.DefaultClient{ID: assertionTestClientID},
+					JSONWebKeys: &josev3.JSONWebKeySet{Keys: []josev3.JSONWebKey{{
+						Key: &key.PublicKey, KeyID: assertionTestKeyID, Use: "sig", Algorithm: "ES256",
+					}}},
+					TokenEndpointAuthMethod:           "private_key_jwt",
+					TokenEndpointAuthSigningAlgorithm: "ES256",
+				},
+			}
+			cfg := &fosite.Config{AccessTokenIssuer: assertionTestIssuer, TokenURL: assertionTestTokenURL}
+			provider := fosite.NewOAuth2Provider(store, newClientAssertionAudienceConfig(cfg))
+			strategy := newClientAssertionErrorStrategy(provider.DefaultClientAuthenticationStrategy)
+
+			claims := jwt.Claims{
+				Issuer:   assertionTestClientID,
+				Subject:  assertionTestClientID,
+				Audience: jwt.Audience{assertionTestTokenURL},
+				ID:       "jti-" + tt.name,
+				IssuedAt: jwt.NewNumericDate(now),
+				Expiry:   jwt.NewNumericDate(now.Add(time.Minute)),
+			}
+			tt.mutate(&claims)
+			if tt.reuse {
+				store.seen[claims.ID] = struct{}{}
+			}
+			kid := assertionTestKeyID
+			if tt.kid != "" {
+				kid = tt.kid
+			}
+			signer := key
+			if tt.signingKey != nil {
+				signer = tt.signingKey
+			}
+			assertion := signAssertion(t, signer, kid, claims)
+
+			if tt.noAssert {
+				assertion = ""
+			}
+			form := url.Values{
+				"client_assertion_type": {jwtBearerClientAssertionType},
+				"client_assertion":      {assertion},
+			}
+			req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, assertionTestTokenURL, strings.NewReader(form.Encode()))
+
+			client, err := strategy(context.Background(), req, form)
+			if tt.wantErr == "" {
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+				assert.Equal(t, assertionTestClientID, client.GetID())
+				return
+			}
+			require.Error(t, err)
+			var rfcErr *fosite.RFC6749Error
+			if tt.wantStatus == 0 {
+				assert.False(t, errors.As(err, &rfcErr), "storage errors must not be rewritten: %v", err)
+				assert.ErrorIs(t, err, tt.setErr)
+				return
+			}
+			require.ErrorAs(t, err, &rfcErr)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.wantErr, rfcErr.ErrorField)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.wantStatus, rfcErr.CodeField)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestClientAssertionErrorStrategy_IgnoresOtherAuthentication(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	want := fosite.ErrInvalidRequest.WithHint("untouched")
+	strategy := newClientAssertionErrorStrategy(
+		func(context.Context, *http.Request, url.Values) (fosite.Client, error) { return nil, want })
+
+	form := url.Values{"client_id": {"c"}}
+	_, err := strategy(context.Background(), httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/", nil), form)
+	assert.Same(t, want, err)
+}
+
+func signAssertion(t *testing.T, key *ecdsa.PrivateKey, kid string, claims jwt.Claims) string {
+	t.Helper()
+	signer, err := jose.NewSigner(
+		jose.SigningKey{Algorithm: jose.ES256, Key: key},
+		(&jose.SignerOptions{}).WithType("JWT").WithHeader(jose.HeaderKey("kid"), kid))
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	token, err := jwt.Signed(signer).Claims(claims).Serialize()
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	return token
+}
